title: Unified platform contracts v1, audit hash chain with Event Log anchors, and provenance and dependency gates (inert)
draft_note: Draft mirror of .specgrain/specs/SG-000131.json, which governs. Its licence text was brought in line with the active spec's 2026-11-17 amendment (licence type no longer blocks; provenance, preserved notices and the owner-asserted authorization reference are required).

dependency_notes.SG-000093: Closed. AuthorityMode, ExecutorClass and ExecutionState move to orcel-contracts with identical serde spellings and are re-exported by orcel-policy; lease ids and binding digests keep their encodings.

objective: Give every unified-platform grain one set of versioned wire contracts in crates/orcel-contracts (principal and device, per-OS identity binding, lease view, grant reference bound to session and client, standing approval, session, tool registry entry, capability discovery with unsupported and permission_required, the job state machine reusing not_started|dispatched|completed|cancelled|outcome_unknown, the audit event, sidecar IPC, web crawl request with scope, headers, privacy profile and declared task, and additive failure codes with a complete HTTP mapping); a SHA-256 hash chain in orcel-audit written before every dispatch and anchored in the Windows Event Log; `orcel audit verify` checking every anchor still in the log; and CI gates requiring pinned provenance, preserved notices and the owner-asserted authorization reference for every copied donor file, provenance for every file carrying a licence marker, pinned lockfiles, and the kernel dependency direction (a licence type blocks nothing, founder decision of 2026-11-17). Nothing becomes reachable by any client. Spec: docs/orcel/implementation-readiness/prep/UNIFIED_INTEGRATION_SPEC.md sections 3, 4.0 to 4.10, 8.2 (WP1-01, WP1-02, WP1-03).

include: WP1-01 (amended 2026-11-17): root deny.toml (bans and sources; licences reported with cargo deny list, not judged); docs/orcel/notices/licence-policy.json and donor-provenance.json; scripts/check-donor-provenance.mjs (pinned provenance, source paths, preserved notice and the owner-asserted authorization reference for every copied file, including files under upstream, vendor, vendored or third_party directories), check-agpl-markers.mjs (a file with a licence marker, or an unreadable file, needs a provenance entry) and check-npm-licenses.mjs (every package pinned, licences reported), each with tests; crates/orceld/tests/dependency_direction.rs; ci.yml wiring.

WP1-02: the contract modules listed in section 8.2 of the spec, golden fixtures, schemars =1.2.3 as a dev-dependency with a schema drift test, canonical_json with the SG-000093/SG-000018/SG-000019/SG-000040 exemptions, the FailureCode variants of section 4.10 and FailureCode::http_status.

WP1-03: chain.rs, verify.rs and anchor.rs in orcel-audit; write-before-dispatch in orceld with refusal on failure; Event Log anchors (event id 4100) through the registered source when the authority service is installed, otherwise an unregistered per-user source proven under a standard account; `orcel audit verify`; digests only for argv, URLs, query strings and header values.
exclude: Any MCP tool, REST route, executor, runtime dependency in crates/*, listener, network path or authority.
Any change to lease issuance, lease ids, binding digests, existing approval digests or Safe-mode policy.
macOS unified log and Linux journal anchors (track X).

authority_delta.audit: None in what is permitted; adds integrity evidence and refuses a dispatch whose evidence cannot be written.
authority_delta.ci: Refusing gates only (provenance, lockfile, source, ban and dependency-direction rules; no licence-type refusal).

decisions.question: Grain id and activation
decisions.status: DECIDED (founder, 2026-11-17, FD-UP-4): SG-000131 covers contracts, the audit chain and licence and provenance checks.

decisions.question: Licensing approach
decisions.status: DECIDED (founder, 2026-11-17, FD-UP-1), then AMENDED the same day (see amendments): a licence type no longer blocks; the gates require provenance, preserved notices and the owner-asserted authorization reference; isolating a component is an architecture choice, not a licence requirement.

invariants: orcel-contracts depends only on serde and serde_json at runtime and contains no platform code.
Existing wire spellings, the orcel-full-control-lease/1 schema and existing digests are unchanged.
Inbound authority-bearing objects refuse unknown fields; LeaseView is never proof.
No dispatch runs without its audit record durably written first.
Audit records never contain a raw SID, token, credential, header value, argv, URL or page content.
No kernel crate depends on an app, test, package or third_party unit.

Every copied file or directory has a pinned provenance entry (repository, commit or release with SHA-256, source paths, original licence recorded, preserved notice, owner-asserted authorization reference).
acceptance: Every contract type round-trips its golden fixture; unknown fields refused where required; schema drift fails CI; every FailureCode is mapped.
orcel-policy tests pass unchanged after the vocabulary move.
Edits, deletions, reorders and tail truncation are reported by `orcel audit verify`; a conflicting anchor record is a break; rotation keeps continuity.
A simulated audit write failure refuses the dispatch.
The anchor write and read-back succeed and clearing the log is refused under a temporary standard account on the Windows runner.
The provenance, licence-marker, lockfile and dependency-direction gates pass on main and fail on their fixtures; a planted AGPL file with a provenance entry passes and without one fails.

amendments.title: SG-000131 WP1-01: provenance instead of licence blocking
amendments.decision: DECIDED (founder, 2026-11-17), typed by the founder, verbatim: "all sources i have sent to you and all sources in the repo are legally and i have permission to copy all of them and re name them to orcel. so not worry about the licness anymore"
amendments.authorization: OWNER-ASSERTED AUTHORIZATION, founder 2026-11-17 (docs/orcel/grants/2026-11-17-founder-attestation.md; no copyright-holder-signed grant is in the repository)
amendments.note: The amendment keeps this spec in state GRAIN and adds no code, dependency, tool, listener or authority by itself; the gates it describes are implemented on branch wp1/licence-gates.
changes: A licence type no longer blocks: no gate refuses AGPL, GPL, LGPL, MPL, SSPL, BUSL, FSL, commercial or unlicensed code or dependencies; dependency licences are reported.

The gates require, for every copied donor file: source repository, pinned commit (or registry release with SHA-256), source path, original licence recorded as it is, the original copyright or attribution notice preserved, and the owner-asserted authorization reference.
A file carrying a licence marker, and a file the scan cannot read, needs a provenance or reviewed reference entry.
Isolating a component (apps/orcel-firecrawl) is an architecture choice, not a licence requirement; the fd06-files.txt allowlist and the 'no Apache unit links an AGPL unit' invariant are withdrawn.
